title: Intrinsic proper/open mates and pasting for varying coefficient systems
statement:
Let $C_1\leftarrow C_2\leftarrow\cdots$ be any inverse sequence of commutative rings, and put $B_{n,T}=(C_n)_T$ on a fixed small skeleton of the pro-etale site of every scheme $T$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Let $\mathscr S_T$ be the category of strict semilinear module systems: an object consists of $B_{n,T}$-module sheaves $M_n$ and $B_{n+1,T}$-linear maps $M_{n+1}\to\operatorname{Res}_{n+1,n}M_n$; morphisms commute with transitions. Use $D(\mathscr S_T)$ and its simultaneous section models [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections]. For a scheme map $v$, let $P_v$ be exact termwise inverse image and $S_v$ total derived direct image, with $P_v\dashv S_v$, unit $\eta_v$ and counit $\varepsilon_v$. For an open immersion $a$, let $J_a\dashv P_a$ be exact termwise extension by zero, with open unit the identity on sections over the open [lem-sf-open-tensor-normalization]. Direct-image compositors are mates of inverse-image compositors [lem-weil-pbc-mate-pasting].

Let $Q$ be a commutative square of schemes with top arrow $k:U\hookrightarrow V$, bottom arrow $i:W\hookrightarrow Z$ quasi-compact open, vertical arrows $r:U\to W$, $p:V\to Z$ proper, and $pk=ir$ [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Set $V_W=V\times_ZW$ with projections $b:V_W\to V$, $q:V_W\to W$, and $s=(k,r):U\to V_W$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Then $s$ is clopen. Let $\pi_s:M\to J_sP_sM$ be projection to the component $s(U)$, identity there and zero on its complementary open. Put
$$\alpha_Q:P_pJ_i\xrightarrow{\beta_{i,p}}J_bP_q\xrightarrow{J_b\pi_sP_q}J_bJ_sP_sP_q\cong J_kP_r,$$
where $\beta$ is the open-unit-normalized map of [lem-sf-open-tensor-normalization], and define its proper mate
$$\Gamma_Q=(S_pJ_k\varepsilon_r)\circ(S_p\alpha_QS_r)\circ(\eta_pJ_iS_r):J_iS_r\to S_pJ_k.$$
There is a canonical isomorphism
$$\lambda_Q:P_iS_pJ_k\cong S_qP_bJ_k\cong S_qJ_s\cong S_qS_s\cong S_r.$$
The first isomorphism is right-adjoint conjugation of the cartesian open comparison $P_pJ_i\cong J_bP_q$; the middle identification $J_s=S_s$ is the clopen section formula. The map $\Gamma_Q$ is the $J_i\dashv P_i$ adjunct of $\lambda_Q^{-1}$, and $\lambda_Q\circ P_i\Gamma_Q=1$ under the open unit.

For vertical pasting $Q_1$ above $Q_2$ with vertical maps $r_1,r_2$ on the left and $p_1,p_2$ on the right, and for horizontal pasting $Q_1$ left of $Q_2$ with top opens $k,l$, bottom opens $i,j$ and verticals $r,p,q$, respectively,
$$\Gamma_{Q_2Q_1}=(S_{p_2}\Gamma_{Q_1})\circ(\Gamma_{Q_2}S_{r_1}),\qquad
\Gamma_{Q_2Q_1}=(\Gamma_{Q_2}J_k)\circ(J_j\Gamma_{Q_1}).$$
For base change $h:Z_1\to Z$, write $a:V_1\to V$, $c:W_1\to W$, $d:U_1\to U$ for the projections, and $Q_1$ for the induced square. Let $E_p:P_hS_p\to S_{p_1}P_a$ and $E_r:P_cS_r\to S_{r_1}P_d$ be the canonical pullback-square mates. Then
$$(S_{p_1}\beta_{k,a})\circ(E_pJ_k)\circ(P_h\Gamma_Q)
=(\Gamma_{Q_1}P_d)\circ(J_{i_1}E_r)\circ(\beta_{i,h}S_r).$$
All equations use the canonical compositors, hold in the semilinear derived categories before evaluation, and are independent of parenthesization. Identity verticals or identity horizontals give identity transformations. They apply also to noncartesian refinement squares, where $r=1$ and $s$ is the clopen section.

If a commutative ring $B$ has compatible maps $B\to C_n$, termwise restriction to constant-$B$ module towers identifies $\Gamma_Q$ with the normalized constant-tower mate of [lem-cbc-strict-tower-proper-open-calculus], via the canonical scalar-restriction direct-image and pullback comparisons of [lem-weil-pbc-ring-sheaf-change-adjunction]. Evaluation gives the same mate over $C_n$. When $C_n$ is finite and the evaluated input has a bounded-below etale-origin witness [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness], it is the specified finite proper/open comparison. No faithfulness of derived evaluation or scalar restriction on morphisms is asserted.

proof.text: Apply the varying-ring proper/open construction [lem-sp-varying-ring-proper-open-pasting] to the inverse sequence $C_1\leftarrow C_2\leftarrow\cdots$ on each fixed small pro-etale skeleton. Its componentwise clopen lift gives $s=(k,r):U\to V_W$, the projection $\pi_s$ and the normalized map $\alpha_Q$; the component maps commute with all semilinear transitions. The simultaneous section models of [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections] then give exact termwise inverse images, derived direct images, open extensions, their units and counits, and the displayed derived mate $\Gamma_Q$. The open-unit normalization is the one supplied by [lem-sf-open-tensor-normalization], so this is the stated intrinsic construction rather than a map chosen after evaluation. S4 realizes the foundational comparisons in Lean as follows. Naturality of the displayed transpose is homEquiv_naturality_right_square applied to the whiskered open unit followed by the inverse square compositor. The already proved varying-ring cartesian counit theorem places P_g(J_j M) in the essential image of J_j'; full faithfulness of open extension makes the specified counit invertible, and the hom-equivalence counit formula proves betaInv invertible. For a clopen immersion the varying-ring derived clopen isomorphism identifies J with R. Transfer full faithfulness along this isomorphism: the proper-adjunction unit on J(M) is invertible, so its composite with R applied to the inverse open unit is the specified invertible openToS. These arguments use only equality of the underlying functors; they do not identify different chosen adjunction structures. For scalar restriction, its prescribed evaluation equations identify every evaluated functor with exact level restriction. Componentwise preservation of finite limits and colimits then proves exactness; preservation of binary products gives additivity. The other steps below remain the plans for the remaining unfinished statements. C8 realizes the termwise scalar-restriction functor by the generic ringed-sequence-site tower construction. The compatible maps of constant ring sheaves give a natural transformation from the constant B sheaf to the coefficient sequence. Composing with the evaluation-ring identifications supplies compatible structural ring maps. The generic construction gives the evaluated functor equations and the section formulas. Componentwise functor extensionality, followed by the transition formulas, proves uniqueness of the entire functor.

proof.text: Restrict $p$ to $W$ and then to $V_W=V\times_ZW$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. By the clopen construction of [lem-sp-varying-ring-proper-open-pasting], $s=(k,r)$ is open and closed, $bs=k$, $qs=r$ and $V_W=s(U)\amalg C$ with $C$ open. On sections over this decomposition, $J_sP_sF=F|_{s(U)}\times0$, so $J_s=S_s$ and $\pi_s$ is the unit $\eta_s:F\to S_sP_sF$ of $P_s\dashv S_s$; these are termwise identities of exact functors, hence identities on the simultaneous section models of [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections]. Since $\beta=\beta_{i,p}:P_pJ_i\cong J_bP_q$ is an isomorphism of left adjoints of $P_iS_p$ and $S_qP_b$ (composite adjunctions), its conjugate is an isomorphism $c:P_iS_p\cong S_qP_b$, characterized by its unit equation [lem-weil-pbc-conjugate-iso-unit-equation], applied in opposite categories. Then $\lambda_Q$ is the composite of $c J_k$, $S_qP_bJ_bJ_s\cong S_qJ_s$ (open unit), $J_s=S_s$ and the compositor $S_qS_s\cong S_r$. To compute $\lambda_Q\circ P_i\Gamma_Q$, transport $P_i\Gamma_Q$ along $c$: by the change-of-adjunction and pasting clauses 1 and 3 of [lem-weil-pbc-mate-pasting], it becomes the $(P_r\dashv S_r,\ P_q\dashv S_q)$-mate of the square $P_b\alpha_Q\circ P_b\beta^{-1}$, which under the open unit is $\pi_sP_q:P_q\to J_sP_sP_q=J_sP_r$. With $\pi_s=\eta_s$ and $J_s=S_s$ this mate is $(S_qS_s\varepsilon_r)\circ(S_q\eta_sP_sP_qS_r)\circ(\eta_qS_r)$, i.e. $(S_qS_s\varepsilon_r)\circ(\eta^{(sq)}S_r)$ for the unit of the composite adjunction $P_sP_q\dashv S_qS_s$. By the triangle identities this is the inverse of the compositor $S_qS_s\cong S_r$. Hence $\lambda_Q\circ P_i\Gamma_Q=1$ under the open unit $P_iJ_i=1$ of [lem-sf-open-tensor-normalization], and since the $J_i\dashv P_i$ adjunct of $\Gamma_Q$ is $P_i\Gamma_Q$ composed with that unit, it is $\lambda_Q^{-1}$; the adjunction bijection makes $\Gamma_Q$ the unique such map. No equality is inferred from evaluation. C8 proves the two pi_components equations separately. For the image equation, identify openToS with the canonical left-to-right transformation of the adjoint triple J_s, P_s, R_s; cancel its invertible image under P_s and use the open triangle identity. For the complement equation, the ordinary varying-ring component theorem and invertibility of the ordinary projector on an extended object imply that P_c J_s has zero objects. Exact localization of this composite preserves zero objects, and the derived composition isomorphism shows the target of the restricted projector is zero.

proof.text: For vertical and horizontal pasting, use the two pasting identities in [lem-sp-varying-ring-proper-open-pasting]. Its intrinsic clopen construction says that the $a$-map for the outer rectangle is the pasted $a$-map, with the canonical inverse-image and open-extension compositors. Applying the mate correspondence to these equalities gives exactly $\Gamma_{Q_2Q_1}=(S_{p_2}\Gamma_{Q_1})\circ(\Gamma_{Q_2}S_{r_1})$ vertically and $\Gamma_{Q_2Q_1}=(\Gamma_{Q_2}J_k)\circ(J_j\Gamma_{Q_1})$ horizontally, with parenthesization handled by the canonical compositors. The identity cases are the identity clauses of the same construction.

proof.text:
For a base change (h:Z_1\to Z), use the induced fibre-product square and write (a,c,d) for its projections. The open comparison ( eta) is normalized by the open unit, so its pullback square commutes with the corresponding ( eta_{i,h}) and ( eta_{k,a}); this is the termwise section-model assertion of [lem-sf-open-tensor-normalization]. The clopen lift pulls back to (s_1=(k_1,r_1)), and the projection (pi_s) pulls back to (pi_{s_1}): on the decomposition into (s(U)) and its complement both maps are ((x,y)\mapsto(x,0)). Consequently the underived alpha square is the pasted square obtained from (alpha_Q), ( eta), and the two pullback maps. Apply the mate correspondence to this equality, inserting the pullback-square mates (E_p:P_hS_p\to S_{p_1}P_a) and (E_r:P_cS_r\to S_{r_1}P_d). Naturality moves the beta factors to the two ends; the adjacent unit-counit pairs cancel by the triangle identities. The remaining equality is
$$(S_{p_1}\beta_{k,a})\circ(E_pJ_k)\circ(P_h\Gamma_Q)=(\Gamma_{Q_1}P_d)\circ(J_{i_1}E_r)\circ(\beta_{i,h}S_r).$$
All operations and mate transposes are simultaneous system maps by [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections], so this is an equality before evaluation.

Let $B\to C_n$ be compatible with the inverse system and let $\rho$ be termwise restriction of scalars from semilinear systems to constant-$B$ towers; it is exact, so $\rho P_v=P^{\mathcal T}_v\rho$, $\rho J_a=J_a\rho$ termwise, and $\rho\alpha_Q=\alpha^{\mathcal T}_Q\rho$ because $\beta$ and $\pi_s$ are the same maps of underlying sheaves. Define $d_v:\rho S_v\to S^{\mathcal T}_v\rho$ at the system level as the mate of $P^{\mathcal T}_v\rho=\rho P_v$, namely $(S^{\mathcal T}_v\rho\varepsilon_v)\circ(\eta^{\mathcal T}_v\rho S_v)$. Evaluation intertwines the system units and counits with the level ones [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections], so $\operatorname{ev}_nd_v$ is the mate of the level comparison $b$ of [lem-weil-pbc-ring-sheaf-change-adjunction]; by its adjunct clause (take $t=\varepsilon$, $t^\sharp=1$) this mate is its isomorphism $d$. Quasi-isomorphisms of towers are detected levelwise, so $d_v$ is an isomorphism. Now paste squares as in clause 1 of [lem-weil-pbc-mate-pasting]: $\alpha_Q$ followed by the $p$-square of $\rho$, and the $r$-square of $\rho$ followed by $\alpha^{\mathcal T}_Q$, are equal squares $P^{\mathcal T}_pJ_i\rho\to\rho J_kP_r$ since $\rho\alpha_Q=\alpha^{\mathcal T}_Q\rho$. Their mates are therefore equal: $(d_pJ_k)\circ\rho\Gamma_Q=(\gamma^{\mathcal T}_Q\rho)\circ(J_id_r)$, with $\gamma^{\mathcal T}_Q$ the normalized mate of [lem-cbc-strict-tower-proper-open-calculus]. This is an equality of system maps, not a consequence of faithfulness. For the evaluation: by [lem-sp-varying-ring-proper-open-pasting], whose $\gamma_Q$ is literally $\Gamma_Q$, $\operatorname{ev}_n\Gamma_Q$ is the constant-$C_n$ clopen-projection mate of [lem-cbc-strict-tower-proper-open-calculus]; for finite $C_n$ and an input whose $n$-th level is $\nu^*L_n$ with $L_n\in D^+(U_{\mathrm{et}},C_n)$, the evaluation clause of that node (with $B=\Lambda_n=C_n$) identifies it with the specified finite proper/open comparison. C8 realizes the ordinary evaluation comparison before taking mates. For the square of sequence-site evaluation and scheme base change, compare the structural ring maps using the adjunction normalization of constant coefficients. Pushforward composition and congruence then construct a comparison whose hom and inverse are both identities on sections. Lift this comparison to constant diagrams; sectionwise extensionality proves uniqueness. For inverse image, identify the level direct-image comparison with the existing moduleEvalP by its section normalization. Lift the existing moduleEvalG isomorphism to constant diagrams. Its unit equation, evaluated at each diagram index, identifies the mate of its inverse with the direct-image comparison. The mates equivalence therefore identifies the specified inverse-image comparison with an invertible map. V2 proves rhoPushOrdinary_existsUnique: at each index, combine pushforward composition and scalar restriction using the naturality square for constant coefficient maps. Both directions are identities on sections. The normalized transition formula for rhoOrdinary makes these comparisons natural in the tower index. Assemble them with NatIso.ofComponents; equality on every section proves uniqueness of the full tower comparison. Generic transport lemmas preserve the normalization without unfolding the chosen functor data.

proof.text: V2 proves compositor_associativity. The section formula for pushComp expresses both threefold direct-image composites as restriction along the canonical iterated fiber-product map. The associativity of Over.pullbackComp identifies those maps, and presheaf composition gives the ordinary direct-image coherence equation. Apply Adjunction.leftAdjointCompIso_assoc to obtain ordinary inverse-image coherence. The exact-derived coherence calculation in [lem-cbc-strict-tower-direct-image-coherence] descends this equation to pComp. Conjugation and its whiskering laws give the sComp equation. Applying leftAdjointCompIso_assoc to the open adjunctions gives the jComp equation. Equality transport is handled by equality elimination, preserving all specified adjunctions and compositors.
